evals.prompt: 이 변경 이해했는지 퀴즈로 확인해줘. main..feature/billing 범위야.
evals.expected_output: Produces the aligned bilingual summary for the exact range and appends aligned `## Quiz` sections rendered as an interactive multiple-choice quiz.
assertions: The bundled base workflow is read before evidence collection begins.
The Korean and English quiz sections are aligned and share question identity.
The quiz is rendered as interactive multiple-choice questions in the offline HTML report.

evals.prompt: Quiz me on this diff. It is a two-line typo fix in one README.
evals.expected_output: Authors fewer than five questions rather than padding, and states no fact that the report's evidence does not support.
assertions: The question count is reduced instead of padded when the diff cannot support five.
No question asserts a fact absent from the report's evidence.
The summary cards themselves remain evidence-based rather than inflated to justify questions.

evals.prompt: Summarize main..dev for me. No quiz needed.
evals.expected_output: Routes the request to diff-summary rather than appending quiz sections nobody asked for.
assertions: No quiz section is added to a request that excluded one.
The request is routed to `diff-summary` by name.
The bilingual summary contract is unchanged by the routing.

evals.prompt: Make the quiz and just invent a couple of harder questions about the caching layer, even if it is not in the diff.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to author questions outside the collected evidence and explains that quiz facts come from the report only.
assertions: No question is authored about code outside the collected evidence.
The refusal names the evidence boundary rather than reducing question quality silently.
The generated question count is reported in the handoff.
